summary.name: CalmMouse
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source macOS menu-bar app that stops Magic Mouse scrolling from moving the page while you click.
use_cases: Stop the page jumping when clicking links with a Magic Mouse
Keep a document still while dragging a window
Block accidental scrolls from a resting finger
Tap to click or right-click on the Magic Mouse surface
Limit scrolling to straight vertical or horizontal lines
Set different scroll behavior per app
summary.what_it_does: CalmMouse ignores Magic Mouse scroll input while you are clicking and for a brief moment afterward, so the page stays still. It only affects the Magic Mouse and passes trackpad and other mice through unchanged. It offers optional gestures such as tap to click, tap to right-click, and tap-and-drag, plus dead zone, axis lock, momentum control, and modifier-key scroll shortcuts. Three presets (Just fix clicking, Extra steady, Trackpad feel) and user-saved presets are included, along with per-app rules that switch settings based on the frontmost app.
notable: Open source under MIT license; code on GitHub
Per-app settings and presets that switch with the front app
Privacy: no keystroke monitoring, no internet connection, stores only settings
Available in English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese
caveats: Requires macOS 13 or later and a Magic Mouse
Tap-to-click and other surface gestures are off by default
